validation_method: user-independent (test users absent during training), 5 user-level folds
features: 14 personalized baseline-ratio features (derived from 26 engineered features)
ablation_note: The 14 personalized features perform almost as well as the full 40-feature combination; personalized features substantially outperform absolute motion features. This motivated the 14-feature deployment candidate.

evaluation._claims_policy: FD-30: evaluation used SYNTHETIC IMU data and is experimental. Never present as validated real-world gamer-frustration accuracy.
